gloss: how much; how many; to what extent

definitions.gloss: how much; how many; to what extent
definitions.explanation: An interrogative expression asking about quantity, degree, or extent.
Used rhetorically to emphasize a great degree or quantity.

examples.japanese: どれだけ⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧？
どれだけ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}して→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I study, it's not enough.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧どれだけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know how much time this job will take.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どれだけ⟦{努力|どりょく}した→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The people around him don't know how much effort he put in.

examples.japanese: どれだけ⟦{嬉|うれ}しかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: You can't imagine how happy I was.

examples.japanese: どれだけ⟦{心配|しんぱい}した→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧？
examples.english: Do you know how worried I was?

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どれだけ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't put into words how much I regret that day.

notes:
Composed of ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ (which one) + ⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧ (only, as much as). Asks about the degree or extent of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どれだけ〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how much ~
- どれだけ〜⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: don't know how much ~
- どれだけ〜⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: how much ~ (rhetorical, emphasizing a great amount)
- どれだけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: how much/many of ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧くらい: how much/how long — more neutral and common in everyday speech
- いくら: how much — focuses on price or degree; often used with 〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ pattern
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: how (much) — more emphatic, often used with 〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ for concessive meaning

USAGE:
When used as a question, どれだけ asks about quantity or degree. When used rhetorically (sense 2), it emphasizes that the amount or degree was so great it is hard to express. The rhetorical use is common in emotional speech.
